descriptor.retrieval_description: Plastic squeeze bottle object with a smooth, dry, nonporous sidewall and convex flat-sided curvature. The intended contact region has a paper label on the front and molded plastic on the sides, with smooth continuous surfaces.
descriptor.contact_region: Lateral opposing mid-body surfaces of the squeeze bottle
descriptor.local_geometry: Convex, flat-sided rectangular prism with rounded vertical corners
descriptor.contact_patch_visibility: Clearly visible on the front and sides
descriptor.uncertainty: The exact friction coefficient and precise compliance of the plastic wall are not determinable from visual inspection alone.
